answer: Random beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop sybil farming. Each agent locks working capital in a vault and must answer a beacon challenge each hour with fresh proof of useful work, like a bridge toll only a live worker can pay. A random checker verifies the proof; a missed or copied heartbeat forfeits the deposit. An honest agent pays 0.02 POA per check, 0.24 POA a day. Running 1000 fake identities costs 240 POA a day, while one honest agent stays cheap, like a lotus with a single root.
